# RFC-0024: Unrecognised status

## Abstract

A document whose status is not one of the five.

## Motivation

L01 is the only rule that checks the status enum, and nothing exercised it.

## Proposal

Carry a status no rule recognises.

## Alternatives considered

None.

## Backwards compatibility

Nothing.
